Class ParameterContentNegotiationStrategy

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.accept.MappingMediaTypeFileExtensionResolver
org.springframework.web.accept.AbstractMappingContentNegotiationStrategy
org.springframework.web.accept.ParameterContentNegotiationStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContentNegotiationStrategy, MediaTypeFileExtensionResolver
public class ParameterContentNegotiationStrategy extends AbstractMappingContentNegotiationStrategy
Strategy that resolves the requested content type from a query parameter. The default query parameter name is "format".

您可以通过 MappingMediaTypeFileExtensionResolver.addMapping(String, MediaType) 注册键（即查询参数的预期值）与 MediaType 之间的静态映射。从 5.0 版本开始，该策略还支持通过 MediaTypeFactory.getMediaType(Resource) 动态查找键。

Since:
3.2
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev
